reviews.text:
This place is absolutely fantastic! I have visited several times with my two dachshunds and have always been very impressed with the care, professionalism, and kindness of the team.

On one occasion, one of my dogs had a grass seed lodged in her ear, which the vet removed incredibly skilfully using a special instrument and, thankfully, without the need for anaesthesia. On another visit, my other dachshund was suffering from an allergic reaction to grass and was very itchy. The vet took the time to explain the different treatment options to help relieve her discomfort.

We also regularly visit for the worming tablets required when travelling back to the UK, and the service is always excellent.

I cannot recommend this place highly enough. It is wonderful to find a vet you can trust and feel confident leaving your beloved pets in their hands. Thank you for always taking such great care of my two girls!

Incredible experience! Wonderful service from the girls who greeted me, the groomer, and Dr. Araceli, who was a sweetheart. My Zeus was so happy! ❤️‍🩹😍 I recommend them 100%. It's so satisfying to leave the vet with all your questions answered! Thank you so much! Without a doubt, the best vet! 👌🏻🙏🏻❤️‍🩹

I've been caring for my puppies for years with the professional and compassionate team at Los Madrazo Veterinary Hospital... Previously from El Escorial and now from Valencia. Araceli is exceptional, always attentive and caring for them with such dedication that we feel they're in the best hands. Furthermore, due to work, we have to travel frequently outside of Spain, and since day one, they've provided all the necessary documentation and have been available to address any issues, looking after them and us as a family.

If I had to travel from the other side of Spain, I definitely wouldn't leave them. Thank you. With love, Goliath and Florencia's dad.
I am very happy with the care my dogs receive. The team at Los Madrazos Hospital can be described as highly efficient, attentive, and incredibly caring towards animals.

The best veterinary clinic, LOS MADRAZOS, has an excellent grooming service. Cristina, the groomer, is amazing; my furry friends never go to any other groomer, and especially Cristina, has an exquisite way with the animals. Araceli, the veterinarian, is a great expert and a very kind person. The assistants are very friendly and treat both the pets and their owners very well. I always recommend this veterinary hospital, Los Madrazo, located on Cedaceros Street.

After a bad experience at another vet, where they ran many tests that ultimately didn't provide any solutions or clear answers, we went to Los Madrazo, and the experience couldn't have been better.

From the very first moment, they were incredibly patient in answering all our questions, explained everything clearly, and, above all, treated our kitten with so much love and care. They even managed to detect some ear parasites that the other vet had told us she didn't have.

We felt heard and reassured at all times, which is very important to us. Their professionalism and the care they put into their work are evident. Without a doubt, we've found our trusted veterinary clinic. ❤️🐱
Super friendly!

Hello Sachi,
We were delighted to see such a positive review, thank you so much! We hope to see you again very soon.

Los Madrazo Veterinary Hospital

The kindness and care my dog ​​(Mia) received from this amazing team of professionals was truly spectacular. We're so lucky to have a place like this in the city center to take our pets. It's the first time we've had a dog in our family, and they explained everything perfectly. We couldn't be in better hands. Thank you, team!

My eternal gratitude for the exceptional care you have always given me and my little ones.

Thank you so much because my little one always ran to come in, and that's thanks to all the love he has always received from you. Thank you so much, Araceli; on every visit, I felt cared for with warmth and affection. Alicia, Ángeles, and Miguel, thank you so much; from the moment I walked through the door, I felt completely welcomed. And what can I say about Cristina? Thank you so much for making my little one look so handsome, always with such boundless affection.

You have not only cared for my little ones, but you have also been there for me during important moments, offering support, peace of mind, and reassurance. Thank you for your constant attention, your patience, and for making every visit a positive experience.

After so many years, I can say that I consider you much more than a veterinary team; you have become almost like family.

With all my love,
Thank you so much, Araceli, Alicia, Ángeles, Cristina, and Miguel.

I've been taking my Remi to the groomer since he was 3 months old and I couldn't be happier. Cristina treats him with so much care and affection and gives him the perfect cut. Araceli, his vet, is incredibly attentive and explains everything calmly. They also always remind us when vaccinations or check-ups are due; the follow-up is impeccable. The whole team is lovely; they treat us like family. 100% recommended.

I took my two kittens there and they were treated like royalty. I've never seen such calm animals at a vet's. The staff were also exceptionally friendly and incredibly kind. I won't be taking them anywhere else now.

The best veterinary hospital and the best professionals ❤️❤️❤️ We couldn't be more grateful for the amazing care our Lulu receives from the entire team at Los Madrazo! We've been going there for years and the quality is always top-notch! Whether it's routine checkups, emergencies, or special cases. Lulu and her family are so thankful to the staff for taking such good care of our little furry friend ❤️

We cannot help but express our gratitude to the team at this clinic: their professionalism, empathy, the breaking down of language barriers (we are Italian and have very limited knowledge of English and Spanish), and their constant presence, even after the visit via WhatsApp, to check on the patient's health progress through the therapeutic treatment. We are truly delighted with the treatment received and the effective care.

Ptolemy thanks

We can no longer express our gratitude to the team of this clinic: professionalism, empathy, overcoming linguistic barriers (so many Italians and our knowledge of English and Spanish is very limited) and a constant presence including after the consultation via WhatsApp, Ascertaining how the state of health evolves with therapeutic treatment. We can't be happier with such clean treatment and such effective care.
Ptolemy les da las gracias.

Just moved to Madrid from the US and finding a vet has been challenging. I luckily found Los Madrazo and they are so thorough with the dogs and so helpful with the registration process and making sure the boys have all of their required shots and any preventative medications for parasites and such! It was also very lucky that they have some staff that do speak English, which was wonderful help since my Spanish is not great! I cannot recommend them enough if you are looking for a great vet that will take the best care of your fur babies!

Hello Genesis,
Thank you so much for sharing your opinion with us.

Los Madrazo Veterinary Hospital

The whole team is lovely and very caring with both people and animals. The veterinarian is very professional and treats the animals with so much love. She takes a lot of time to explain everything very clearly. It's wonderful to have a clinic like this; it inspires a lot of confidence.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for twelve years and I'm very happy. Everyone is incredibly professional, from the reception staff to the veterinarian. Highly recommended. It's a shame they've been offering fewer and fewer services in recent years.
The best vet ever. The vets are very nice. We bring Dulce and Luna and they always treat them very well. My rating is 100.
The team at Los Madrazos is fantastic. Araceli is very thorough and friendly, and Cristina is the best dog groomer of all.

Simply the best!
We are extremely grateful to the entire team. They always treated our kitten with the utmost care, affection, and professionalism. They were always incredibly attentive to both Otto and us, and that's not something you find everywhere. We appreciate them and are so grateful!
Apollo and Althea couldn't be in better hands.

I'm giving it 5 stars because I can't give more.

FINALLY, after many years, I feel at ease surrounded by professionals who, above all, work out of passion.

They're currently doing a study on my dog. From the very beginning, the guidelines have been very clear, very well explained, and the service exceptional.

But I have to add that all the women who work there, and whom I've met, are clearly just as dedicated.

I'm so grateful to you all, from the bottom of my heart. And unfortunately, I understand that you're so overwhelmed with work.
Excellent service. Top-notch customer service. They helped us with our dogs' international travel paperwork in record time. 100% recommended.
